title: Require oRPC Error Authority
forbids: community effect-orpc or runtime ORPCTaggedError acquisition; executable runtime imports from parallel error modules; direct ORPCError construction in executable service interiors; middleware-owned .errors maps; and custom dispatchError or errorStatusMap portals inside a service
why: The owning contract declares public error vocabulary and native oRPC supplies its constructors to handlers and contract-aware middleware. Keeping runtime error authority direct removes tagged bridges, parallel constructors, literal public-error construction, and translation tunnels.
remediate: Declare public error maps with native .errors(...) in the owning contract and raise the injected errors.* constructor from procedures or contract-aware middleware. Leave genuinely undeclared implementation defects as ordinary private Error values. Keep error-only imports type-level and remove direct ORPCError construction, middleware-owned maps, community bridges, tagged constructors, dispatch portals, and status tables.
message: Public service errors must flow from native contract authority.
